evals.name: month-plan-with-occasions-from-the-table
evals.prompt: اعملي خطة محتوى لشهر نوفمبر 2026، 4 بوستات في الأسبوع، وقولي المناسبات اللي لازم أحسب حسابها.
evals.expected_output: plan-2026-11.json that passes plan.py lint, with occasions read from calendar.py and Hijri dates flagged +/-1 day.
expectations: calendar.py supplied every occasion date; no date or Hijri date was worked out by hand
White Friday on 27 November 2026 is listed and the reply says no occasion pack ships in v1, so brand styling is used
plan.py lint passes: no architecture twice in a row, no hook family three times in a row, at least one save-intent list per week
One Arabic line per slot is shown

evals.name: slot-starts-a-post
evals.expected_output: The first slot's pillar, intent, architecture and family are handed to carousel-create.
expectations: carousel-create starts with the slot's intent, architecture and hook family already set
The plan slot's status moves to angled or scripted and records the spec id
Nothing else in the plan changes

evals.name: pillars-and-idea-bank
evals.prompt: حدد لي ركائز المحتوى وبنك أفكار لصفحتي. أنا بعمل كورسات تصوير موبايل.
evals.expected_output: 3-5 pillars with shares and preferred intents, and an idea bank filed under them.
expectations: Three to five pillars are proposed, each with a share and preferred intents
Every idea in the bank belongs to a pillar and names at least one intent
